g.text: I know your past is a touchy subject, but...
That skana of yours, I'm really curious about it.
Well, I could call you *Petersham* if you prefer.
I'm still really curious about that skana.
The red bandana that's tied to the blade. Whose was it?
Okay, now I know you're pulling my leg.
Nobodies. It's my favourite colour, remember?
Courtesy of Doctor E. Ran me straight through.
I get to be dramatic when I earned the sword by getting stabbed with it.
Why do I get the feeling that's not the truth?
You have a very odd way of letting a man know you find him attractive.
I had stronger words for it at the time.
You aren't exactly the easiest person to approach, Arthur.
I don't have a lot of practice at this.
I get it. You're trying to make friends. Get to know me.
So I'm trying to break through the ice any way I can.
And I'm not making it easy on you.
There are some cans of worms I'm not bloody willing to open for you yet.
I know, I know. And you've already tried.
I... well, if you're serious, now's not the right time, but...
Bless your stubborn heart for consistency, I suppose.
The red bandana tied on it. Who did it belong to?
Sheesh, didn't realize you'd make such a big deal out of this.
But be honest, am I doomed here?
No grudges held. I'm not an easy man to get along with, sometimes. Sol knows a lot of people around here have learned that lesson...
Mmm, I'm keeping my options open.
All right then. I'm going to go off and have a serious think.
I'm just not the easily sharing type. But maybe well get there, someday.
Heh. Good to know. Something to look forward to.
Here's a toast to Someday, then.
Can I ask how you got the skana in the first place?
